# betteredge Provider

Manages projects and Trusted Execution Domains (TEDs) on the BetterEdge platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    betteredge = {
      source = "real-cis/betteredge"
    }
  }
}

provider "betteredge" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token used to authenticate with the BetterEdge platform (sent as the `X-Token` header). Can also be set via the `BETTEREDGE_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `platform_url` (String) Base URL of the BetterEdge platform API. Can also be set via the `BETTEREDGE_PLATFORM_URL` environment variable.
